.acl -- Manage console ACLs (Onesimus)

USAGE
  .acl
  .acl list [console=<console>]
  .acl set console=<console> [jobacl=<jobacl>[,...] ...] [clientacl=<clientacl>[,...] ...] [storageacl=<storageacl>[,...] ...] [scheduleacl=<scheduleacl>[,...] ...] [poolacl=<poolacl>[,...] ...] [commandacl=<commandacl>[,...] ...] [filesetacl=<filesetacl>[,...] ...] [catalogacl=<catalogacl>[,...] ...] [whereacl=<whereacl>[,...] ...] [pluginoptionsacl=<pluginoptionsacl>[,...] ...]
  .acl delete console=<console> [jobacl[=<jobacl>[,...]] ...] [clientacl[=<clientacl>[,...]] ...] [storageacl[=<storageacl>[,...]] ...] [scheduleacl[=<scheduleacl>[,...]] ...] [poolacl[=<poolacl>[,...]] ...] [commandacl[=<commandacl>[,...]] ...] [filesetacl[=<filesetacl>[,...]] ...] [catalogacl[=<catalogacl>[,...]] ...] [whereacl[=<whereacl>[,...]] ...] [pluginoptionsacl[=<pluginoptionsacl>[,...]] ...]
  .acl clear console=<console>
  .acl copy from=<from> to=<to>

DESCRIPTION
  Shows and changes the catalog tier of the two-tier console ACLs. The ACL directives of the Console and Profile resources are the outer frame (changed in the editor); the catalog ACL can only restrict further. Effective is what both allow.

  set, delete, clear and copy need the CommandACL .acl and configure. Entries are comma separated; commas inside {}, [] or () belong to the entry (regular expressions), a repeated key adds entries.

SUBCOMMANDS
  .acl list
      File and catalog entries, effective result
  .acl set
      Replace catalog entries of types
  .acl delete
      Delete catalog entries
  .acl clear
      Delete every catalog entry of a console
  .acl copy
      Copy the catalog entries of a console

ARGUMENTS
  .acl list
    console=<console>
        Console name (name; values from .consoles)
  .acl set
    console=<console>
        Console name (name; values from .consoles; required)
    jobacl=<jobacl>[,...] ...
        Catalog ACL entries (comma list, repeatable) (text; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    clientacl=<clientacl>[,...] ...
        Catalog ACL entries (comma list, repeatable) (text; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    storageacl=<storageacl>[,...] ...
        Catalog ACL entries (comma list, repeatable) (text; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    scheduleacl=<scheduleacl>[,...] ...
        Catalog ACL entries (comma list, repeatable) (text; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    poolacl=<poolacl>[,...] ...
        Catalog ACL entries (comma list, repeatable) (text; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    commandacl=<commandacl>[,...] ...
        Catalog ACL entries (comma list, repeatable) (text; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    filesetacl=<filesetacl>[,...] ...
        Catalog ACL entries (comma list, repeatable) (text; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    catalogacl=<catalogacl>[,...] ...
        Catalog ACL entries (comma list, repeatable) (text; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    whereacl=<whereacl>[,...] ...
        Catalog ACL entries (comma list, repeatable) (text; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    pluginoptionsacl=<pluginoptionsacl>[,...] ...
        Catalog ACL entries (comma list, repeatable) (text; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
  .acl delete
    console=<console>
        Console name (name; values from .consoles; required)
    jobacl[=<jobacl>[,...]] ...
        Entries to delete; without value every entry of the type (text; the value may be left out; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    clientacl[=<clientacl>[,...]] ...
        Entries to delete; without value every entry of the type (text; the value may be left out; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    storageacl[=<storageacl>[,...]] ...
        Entries to delete; without value every entry of the type (text; the value may be left out; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    scheduleacl[=<scheduleacl>[,...]] ...
        Entries to delete; without value every entry of the type (text; the value may be left out; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    poolacl[=<poolacl>[,...]] ...
        Entries to delete; without value every entry of the type (text; the value may be left out; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    commandacl[=<commandacl>[,...]] ...
        Entries to delete; without value every entry of the type (text; the value may be left out; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    filesetacl[=<filesetacl>[,...]] ...
        Entries to delete; without value every entry of the type (text; the value may be left out; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    catalogacl[=<catalogacl>[,...]] ...
        Entries to delete; without value every entry of the type (text; the value may be left out; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    whereacl[=<whereacl>[,...]] ...
        Entries to delete; without value every entry of the type (text; the value may be left out; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
    pluginoptionsacl[=<pluginoptionsacl>[,...]] ...
        Entries to delete; without value every entry of the type (text; the value may be left out; several values separated by commas; may be repeated)
  .acl clear
    console=<console>
        Console name (name; values from .consoles; required)
  .acl copy
    from=<from>
        Source console (name; values from .consoles; required)
    to=<to>
        Target console (name; values from .consoles; required)

EXAMPLES
  .acl list console=ops
      file and catalog ACL of ops
  .acl set console=ops jobacl=Backup-*,Restore commandacl=status,list
      restrict ops
  .acl delete console=ops jobacl
      remove the catalog JobACL entries

ORIGIN
  Onesimus extension. The Bareos Director does not know this command and answers "is an invalid command".

SEE ALSO
  configure, .profiles
